objective: Review Azure DevOps PR 5240 (seeded-defect E2E test, team leave calendar) as a merge gate against the saved ess-be project rules, with Laya's independent severity check in shadow mode.

steps.title: Fetch PR
steps.assumption: Current folder is a checkout of ess-be
steps.result: 8 files, 360-line patch, 7 existing threads (6 earlier AI review summaries), no work items, no secrets

steps.title: Project rules
steps.result: Saved user-level rules found and used; no custom instructions file

steps.title: Review (inline)
steps.assumption: 8 files / ~300 lines is small enough for one inline pass instead of fan-out
steps.result: Whole patch read; 15 candidate findings across all axes

steps.title: Verification
steps.result: Confirmed entity names, ID365Service signature (no CancellationToken, so AS-02 dropped), middleware ValidationException mapping; dropped a multi-day-leave finding because EssLeaveApprovedRequests rows are per booked day; mandatory scans hit only D-07

steps.title: Findings file
steps.result: Heredoc failed on quote parsing; rewrote with the Write tool (one wasted turn plus a read-before-write turn)

steps.title: Laya severity check
steps.result: shadow: 10 agree, 5 differ (all low confidence), 0 flagged; merge question agrees Blocked (log only)

steps.title: Assess
steps.result: Request Changes, Blocked, score 0, 4 Critical / 7 Major / 3 Minor / 1 Suggestion, coverage 8/8

insights: Write JSON files with the Write tool, not a Bash heredoc, to avoid quote-parsing failures.
Files from earlier runs of the same PR need a Read before Write; read one line first to save a turn.
Earlier AI review threads on the same commit already covered the Critical points; reading the latest one early helps cross-check coverage.
